لاشيء

Translation status: العربية reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the ar pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Represents the null value and can prefix a null check.

Syntax: نوع_لاشيء [<expression>]

Category#

literal

Related#

  • ∪
  • اختياري
  • nihil

Examples#

radix/corpus/literalia/nihil.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Null literal and nullable union bindings.

# =============================================================================
# نوع_لاشيء — Null literal and nullable union bindings.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • the `نوع_لاشيء` literal — represents absence of a value (null)
#   • nullable union types with `∪` — `T ∪ نوع_لاشيء` for values that may be absent
#   • null checks with `est نوع_لاشيء` and `ليس est نوع_لاشيء`
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Using نوع_لاشيء without declaring the type as T ∪ نوع_لاشيء — نوع_لاشيء requires a nullable union type.
#
# See also: ∪, اختياري, نوع_لاشيء
# =============================================================================

# literalia/nihil — نوع_لاشيء literal and T ∪ نوع_لاشيء
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   literal :← 'نوع_لاشيء'
#   unionType :← type '∪' 'نوع_لاشيء'
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   نوع_لاشيء, صواب, 42
#
# BACKEND:
#   Cross-ref نوع_لاشيء/nihil.fab.

fn maybe() → int ∪ none {
    return 42
}

main {
    const int ∪ none absent ← null
    print absent
    const bool nihilne ← absent is none
    print nihilne
    print maybe() not is none
}

Expected output:

nihil
verum
verum

# =============================================================================
# نوع_لاشيء — Represents the null value and can prefix a null check.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • the `نوع_لاشيء` keyword — used for null/none values
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Using نوع_لاشيء without ∪ in the type position — nullable types must be declared as T ∪ نوع_لاشيء.
#
# See also: ∪, اختياري
# =============================================================================

# نوع_لاشيء — null literal
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   literal :← 'نوع_لاشيء'
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   Scalar stdout smoke (see body).
#

main {
    const none nothing ← null
    print nothing
}

Expected output:

nihil
